description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing UI panels in SuiteCRM, including initializing, expanding, collapsing panels, and setting their collapse state with cookie storage.

methods.name: initPanel
methods.description: Initializes a panel by expanding or collapsing it based on the given state.

methods.name: expandPanel
methods.description: Expands a specified panel by updating its CSS class.

methods.name: collapsePanel
methods.description: Collapses a specified panel by updating its CSS class.

methods.name: setCollapseState
methods.description: Sets the collapse state of a panel and stores it in a cookie.
